name: Lost in Aimless Chaos
body:
School illusion (glamer) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 5, sorcerer/wizard 5
Components V, S, M (a prism)
Saving Throw Will, see text; Spell Resistance see text

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as hallucinatory terrain except the terrain created is chaotic and constantly shifting. Any creature within the area or entering it must make a Will save or be confused as per the spell confusion for 1 round. Only the confusion effect is considered mind-affecting and is subject to spell resistance.
